plan.subject: Understand the fundamental concepts of linear regression, including its formulation, cost function, and optimization techniques.
plan.objective: Understand the fundamental concepts of linear regression, including its formulation, cost function, and optimization techniques.

blocks.title: What is Linear Regression
blocks.teachingObjective: Linear regression is the foundation of predictive modeling in statistics and machine learning.
examples: Linear regression is characterized by linearity and continuity, with the output predicted as a linear combination of input features.

blocks.title: Cost Function and Mean Squared Error
blocks.teachingObjective: The cost function is essential for evaluating and improving the performance of a linear regression model.
examples: The mean squared error (MSE) is used as the cost function to minimize the error between predicted and actual values.

blocks.title: Gradient Descent Optimization
blocks.teachingObjective: Gradient descent is a critical algorithm for minimizing the cost function in linear regression.
examples: Using an iterative optimization algorithm, gradient descent minimizes the cost function by adjusting the model parameters.

blocks.title: Model Formulation and Parameters
blocks.teachingObjective: Understanding how to formulate a linear regression model is key to applying it in practice.
examples: The regression coefficient represents the slope of the line, determining how much the output changes with a unit change in the input.
